summary: Fractal web: the conversation composer attaches and pastes up to four images, uploads them on send and names their blob references in message.send

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

schema.detail: No schema change. Uses the existing blob upload route and message.send attachments.

compatibility.detail: Attach appears only on devices granted control.messages and message.send; other devices keep the text-only composer.

recovery.detail: Revert the pull request; text sends are unchanged.
